name: Krea2 Slider collection OFF / ON / protected-priority hybrid comparison

seed.notes: Set the same value in all five Samplers; UI control_after_generate stays fixed.

steps.notes: Set all five together; collect_step must not exceed steps. The reference budget below assumes 8.

cfg.notes: Must remain 1.0 for the current implementation.

trial_id.notes: Increment all five together for a fresh run with the same seed; leave unchanged when intentionally reusing cached collection.

slider_strength.notes: Change ON upstream loader plus all FINAL sampler strengths together. Collector sampler strength stays zero. Zero/nonstandard values change the expected NFE or experiment.

slider_lora.notes: Use the same compatible trained Slider file everywhere, including the required collector lora_name although own strength is zero.

style_lora.notes: One shared global style Loader; do not use the Slider as this style.

style_strength.notes: Shared by every path; changing it recollects both banks.

prompt.default: Photorealistic full-body photograph of exactly two fully clothed adults standing side by side on the same studio floor, facing the camera. On the left is an adult woman in a sage-green top and black trousers. On the right is an adult man in a blue T-shirt and black trousers. Both entire figures are visible, with space above their heads and below their shoes, at a consistent scale and camera distance. One continuous pale gray concrete wall and floor, soft even daylight, consistent exposure and natural shadows.
prompt.notes: Keep exact target/protected phrases present and unambiguous; update all four Subjects nodes together if phrases change.

target_phrase.notes: Same semantic target in collection and all FINAL branches.

protected_phrase.notes: Same protected person in collection and all FINAL branches.

target_occurrence.notes: Update together if a phrase occurs more than once.

protected_occurrence.notes: Update together if a phrase occurs more than once.

collect_step.notes: Collectors only; manual FINAL nodes ignore this setting.

selection_dilate_radius.notes: FINAL selection only; both collector values remain 0. Does not guarantee an unchanged exterior.

mask_semantics.raw_T_off: preview OFF output 0, unmodified collector target partition
mask_semantics.raw_P_off: preview OFF output 1, unmodified collector protected partition
mask_semantics.raw_T_on: preview ON output 0, unmodified collector target partition
mask_semantics.raw_P_on: preview ON output 1, unmodified collector protected partition
mask_semantics.hybrid: clamp(T_on - P_off, 0, 1), using builtin MaskComposite subtract at x=y=0
mask_semantics.conflict: T_on * P_off, using builtin MaskComposite multiply at x=y=0
mask_semantics.old_minus_new: clamp(T_off - T_on, 0, 1), saved only; never applied as an erase mask

artifact_limits: Ordinary mask PNGs are quantized display exports at the bank mask resolution; they are not unnormalized similarity tensors or a complete collection audit.
Collector continuation images are reference images only and are never FINAL sampler inputs.

Final DiagnosticSave reports have manual provenance and the final style-only model path; they do not capture a machine-validated OFF/ON collection contract. Preserve API/UI JSON, selected model filenames/hashes, settings, and collected masks together.
ON collection changes the upstream model globally and is provisional; it does not guarantee geometry correction, isolated subject changes, or protected/background pixel invariance.

nfe_estimate.assumptions: Cold execution; both shared collectors each run once, collect_step=2, steps=8, three nonzero target_mask FINAL samplers. Model NFE counts exclude VAE work, mask operations and audit overhead. Isolated budgets require pruning all unrelated terminal outputs and their unused ancestors; muting only a FINAL save leaves connected mask/reference saves active.

rerun_guidance: ComfyUI may reuse cached sampler outputs. Increment trial_id on all five Samplers together for a fresh timed comparison. A prefix change alone does not invalidate sampler caches. Use new distinct output prefixes for separate experimental runs and keep the API/UI JSON alongside artifacts. Never set collectors to own nonzero strength or connect ON loader 10 to a FINAL sampler.
prerequisites: ComfyUI with Krea2 CLIPLoader type and the compatible checkpoint/CLIP/VAE model files.
Existing FreeFuse-for-sliderlora nodes matching source revision 4c53e667; no collection_mode or new diagnostic schema is required.
Replace model and LoRA filenames with installed equivalents if needed; default CLIP is qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors.
UI JSON is imported through the ComfyUI editor; API JSON is the prompt object for POST /prompt, not a complete HTTP request body.
